name: herdr-workflows
description: External Codex workflow plugin for configuring and running portable Herdr multi-agent workflows

interface.shortDescription: Initialize and run Herdr multi-agent workflows
interface.longDescription: Use the external Herdr Workflows plugin to initialize Agent roles, Superpowers, and project workflows, route Herdr completion events directly between roles, and execute multi-agent workflows without Leader polling.
